footer.aboutText: We are a community of rural artisans in Bangladesh creating beautiful, durable products from natural banana fiber.

home.metaDescription: Baskets, bags, mats and home decor handwoven from natural banana fiber by rural artisans in Bangladesh. Cash on delivery across the country.
home.heroBody: Crafted with care and inspired by traditional Bangladeshi craftsmanship.
home.heroImageAlt: A woven banana fiber basket, tote bag and round mat grouped together
home.categoriesSubtitle: Find what you need for your home.
home.featuredSubtitle: A few of the pieces our customers come back for.
home.whySubtitle: Four things we will not compromise on.
home.whyNaturalBody: Banana fiber, jute and cane. No plastic, no synthetic coatings.
home.whyHandmadeBody: Every piece is woven by hand, not by machine. No two are identical.
home.whyEcoBody: Made from the part of the banana plant that is usually thrown away.
home.whyArtisansBody: Your order goes directly to the families who made the product.
home.howSubtitle: From the banana plant in the field to the basket in your home.
home.howStep1Body: After the fruit is harvested, the trunk is usually discarded. We collect it instead.
home.howStep1Alt: A young banana plant with broad leaves
home.howStep2Body: The trunk is stripped into long strands, washed, and dried in the sun for several days.
home.howStep2Alt: Strands of banana fiber laid out to dry
home.howStep3Body: Artisans weave the dried fiber by hand. A large mat can take four days to finish.
home.howStep3Alt: Fiber being woven by hand on a frame
home.howStep4Body: Each piece is checked, trimmed and packed before it is listed for sale.
home.howStep4Alt: A finished woven basket ready for delivery
home.storyBody: Our workshop is in Jhenaidah, where most of the weaving is done at home between other work. Artisans are paid per finished piece at a rate agreed before the work starts, and they keep their own hours.
home.storyBodySecondary: We are a small operation and we would rather grow slowly than change how any of that works.
home.storyImageAlt: An artisan weaving a banana fiber basket by hand
home.storyPlaceholderNote: Placeholder copy. To be replaced with verified information about our community.
